title: Scoping explorer of accelerometer-based prediction models for 24-hour movement behaviour analysis (SCOPE-MOVE): An interactive web application
description:
SCOPE-MOVE is an interactive Shiny web application for exploring evidence from wrist accelerometer prediction model validation studies for 24-hour movement behaviours (physical activity intensity, activity type, sleep-wake, and energy expenditure). The application supports filtering by study and model characteristics and provides visual summaries, pooled estimates, and method contrasts aligned with the accompanying study. This Zenodo record archives a tagged release of SCOPE-MOVE for reproducibility and citation. The specific release version is shown in the Version field of this record.

Source code repository: https://github.com/miltheo/SCOPE-MOVE
Live application: https://miltheo.shinyapps.io/SCOPE-MOVE/

When citing this version of SCOPE-MOVE, please cite this Zenodo record (version-specific DOI). For citing the project independent of version, use the concept DOI shown on the record page.
